close_reason: Fixed in commit 0a91576. Inserted the canonical account_exists guard in handle_metadata_set, matching jmap-mail-server's handle_mailbox_set and this crate's own handle_metadata_changes. Added integration test set_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found_and_does_not_mutate covering both the accountNotFound contract and the no-backend-mutation invariant. All 30 metadata-server tests pass; clippy --all-features clean.
description:
metadata.rs:280-291 — handle_metadata_set extracts account_id then immediately calls backend.get_state::<Metadata>(caller, &account_id) WITHOUT calling backend.account_exists() first.

Compare with handle_metadata_changes at metadata.rs:105-111, handle_metadata_get (delegates to jmap_server::handlers::handle_get which does check), handle_metadata_query / handle_metadata_query_changes (same — delegated check). Compare with the canonical jmap-mail-server handle_mailbox_set at mailbox.rs:442-446 which DOES check.

Trigger: client sends {"accountId": "acc-does-not-exist", "create": {...}} to Metadata/set.

Actual behavior:
- backend.get_state::<Metadata>(caller, &account_id) is called for the bogus account. MemoryBackend at memory.rs:413 returns State::from("0") (default) — no error.
- The create/update/destroy loops then call backend.create_object / update_object / destroy_object against the bogus account_id. MemoryBackend at memory.rs:637 unconditionally inserts account_id into known_accounts and proceeds — so a /set against an unknown account silently *creates the account*.

Expected (RFC 8620 §1.6.2): unknown accountId → top-level accountNotFound error response, no backend mutation.

Severity reasons:
1. Wire-protocol contract violation. Spec mandates accountNotFound for unknown account; getting back a partial /set response and a silently-created account is a data-integrity bug.
2. Cookie-cutter divergence from canonical jmap-mail-server. Per workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates" the sibling MUST mirror canonical handler shape; the absent account_exists check is a propagation regression.
3. The MemoryBackend's auto-account-create behavior in create_object is itself a separate concern but compounds the bug.

Fix: insert the standard account_exists block at the top of handle_metadata_set, immediately after extract_account_id. Mirror mail-server's pattern verbatim.

Tests to add: integration test asserting Metadata/set against an unknown accountId returns accountNotFound and does NOT mutate backend state.
title: handle_metadata_set skips account_exists check — unknown accountId silently calls backend
